title: HtmlSub
responsibility: Renders the native sub element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlSub.attributes
inputs.description: Native sub attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlSub.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native sub element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlSub
outputs.description: The actual native sub element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
